aggregates.p95Method: Nearest rank ceil(0.95*n); descriptive small-sample tail, not a population estimate.

columnDefinitions.cachedSourceKindBeforeSelection: Omitted when no decoded source was cached; retained canvas ownership is separate.
columnDefinitions.chargedPreviewBytes: App ownership accounting, not physical footprint or aggregate admission reservations.
columnDefinitions.firstPublicationMilliseconds: Selection/loadSelection start to current AppModel publication; synchronous retained canvas is observed at return, otherwise the current revision waits for loading/rendering to stop.
columnDefinitions.fullSettledMilliseconds: Same start to current rawFull publication and aligned statistics, with rendering, loading, background work, retained snapshot work, and stack analysis drained.
columnDefinitions.memory.physicalFootprintBytes: Mach TASK_VM_INFO phys_footprint, sampled after settling.
columnDefinitions.memory.processLifetimePeakPhysicalFootpr: Mach ledger_phys_footprint_peak; cumulative process lifetime peak, not each switch peak.
columnDefinitions.memory.reusableBytes: Mach TASK_VM_INFO reusable, distinct from physical footprint.
columnDefinitions.memoryPressureHandlingCount: Every true app drop-handler invocation; false release calls do not increment. Zero through the pre-simulation phases.
columnDefinitions.work.lookaheadSubmissions: Scheduler submissions, including work canceled before native decoding; native completion, cancellation, admission skip, and rejection counts are not exposed.
columnDefinitions.work.publishedFullSourceDecodes: Completed full-source results accepted after cancellation/generation guards, before speculative admission; not all native decodes or admitted sessions.

correctnessGuards.finalCorrectedHashPhase: First frame after its post-navigation EV 0 to 0.25 edit; other seven frames at configured EV 0. The first-frame pre-edit warmup hash is checked inside the harness but not emitted.
correctnessGuards.result: Completed passing compiled harness; independent publication verification validates reported rows and provenance, without independently decoding or hashing every navigation raster.

limits: Programmatic AppModel publication, not native-input or screen-presentation latency.
Immediate retained-canvas publication and settled full-source output are timed separately; no full-detail first-display claim is made.
Each named frame receives a settled full-source warmup; filesystem caches are uncontrolled.

Exactly eight unique sources use the default depth eight and normal 3 GiB budget. With zero pressure drop-handler calls asserted before deliberate simulation, loss of previously warmed full sessions below depth eight demonstrates byte/reservation eviction; charged bytes need not reach the admission reservation limit.
Selected full-source cache presence and charged bytes within budget are asserted. Aggregate admission reservation bytes are not directly exposed or measured.
Charged preview bytes are accounting, distinct from process physical footprint.
Peak footprint covers the process lifetime and is not a per-switch peak.
Pressure is simulated by the app handler, not induced system-wide memory pressure.

The pressure handling count observes every true drop-handler call, including OS notifications and deliberate simulation; false calls do not increment it. The default three-source mode reports this count without requiring zero.
Full-source decode count covers completed results accepted after cancellation/generation guards, before speculative admission; it is not a count of all native decodes or admitted sessions.

Lookahead count is scheduler submissions, including work cancelled before native decoding. Admission skips, rejected speculative results, native completions, and native cancellations are not separately counted.
This current-source cohort and descriptive samples do not establish general performance or memory gains or before/after capacity improvement.
Bitmap hashes and source hashes check reuse correctness, not photographic quality or independent CPU/Metal parity.
Close All and weak-model release establish ownership release, not return of all physical memory to the OS.
Source/toolchain binary-manifest evidence should accompany this report for comparisons.
Three settled full sessions do not establish an exact capacity ceiling: speculative admission reservations are not exposed and rawDetail sessions also occur.
The unusually low settled physical footprints are preserved exactly after source/field/provenance verification. Their cause and relationship to reusable pages are not established.
This publication verifier reads report/source/archive/binary bytes, not private input images. Input immutability and every-navigation pixel equality were asserted by the passing compiled harness.
The raw report status says baseline collection; there is no matched old-source capacity control or before/after capacity result.
